status: Component freeze; final assembly export and combined checks pending

motion_rules.shock: Local X=[side,0,0]; local Z=normalize(moving eye-fixed eye); local Y=Z cross X. Anchor body parts at the fixed eye and rod parts at the moving eye. Preserve raw component geometry without scaling.
motion_rules.shock_pins: Upper pins and sleeves retain proper side orientation. Lower pins and sleeves follow Rx(side*q) about the lower root pivot, rather than the damper axial tilt.
motion_rules.drive: Source +Z points inboard. Apply Rx90, then proper Rz180 on the right, then station translation. Source wheel plane is at Y=side*928, Z=-250 mm. Apply upright motion before rotor spin. Never reflect the rear motor.

replacement_policy: Remove the previous C03 structural 76-node assembly and both old C02 middle structures before loading the new 126-node structural assembly.
Remove old EVO wheels, pattern adapters, proposed output studs, unretained outer pins, tie tubes/inserts and bearing reservations.

The retained-joint 816-node module supplies their replacements. Keep all 816 joint nodes, including actuator retention. Configure actuator-scene retentionOwner="joints" to suppress its eight duplicate retention nodes.
Instance the 20-node direct-drive module six times. Stator and eight screws follow the upright; hub, five studs and five nuts spin with the wheel.
Instance the 24-node guided spring module six times. Remove previous centerline reservations, old perches and old shock pins.

load_paths.wheel: Tire -> rim and five R14 nut seats -> WD220 output flange and purchased bearing assembly -> stator flange -> eight M10 screws/pilot -> original carrier -> retained outer joints -> continuous hollow wishbones -> retained root bearings -> split clamps -> R07 rails.
load_paths.spring: Spring end planes -> original guided perches -> welded carrier stays -> retained shared 12.7 mm pins -> sleeved clevis ears. Upper tower loads the rail clamp. Lower crossbrace loads inclined CHS legs, closed RHS outrigger and both lower wishbone branches.
load_paths.steering: Retained B068 actuator eyes -> translating rack -> retained inner ball -> threaded rod end/tube/outer rod end -> retained outer ball -> steering horn and carrier.

service_gates: The installed tire obstructed the old outer-pin extraction corridor; that corridor was not a complete service path.
Control stored spring energy and mechanically support the suspension before removing shared pins.
The new supports and direct wheel require fresh S01 fixture and tool-approach checks.
qualification_gates: Drive bearing rating and increased wheel offset
Wheel/nut application, grade, torque and finished seat datum
Thread classes, bolt preload and welded load paths
Spring rate, equilibrium, buckling and fatigue
Damper exterior fit, guide wear/lubrication/seals and stop loads
Actuator force, duty and braking/control integration
